description: Compound questions for evaluating query decomposition. Each question asks more than one thing; 'gold' lists the parts as (intent, countries) the system should answer. Questions with a single gold part are controls that must not be split. Tune on 'dev' only; report 'test'. The test split was written at the same time as dev, before any tuning, by the author of the rules, so it is not an independent held-out set.
